name: Antifire Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Antifire NEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Irit x1, Blue Dragon Scale Dust x1, Glass Vessel x1

description:
Antifire potion applies the perk Antifire, which removes Burning stacks and grants 33% resistance from Burning buildup for 300 seconds (5 minutes). It is crafted with irit, blue dragon scale dust, and glass vessel.

(Journal)
While the antifire potion is a miraculous thing and one of the most useful items on Ashenfall, it does have a flaw. It can be hard to know when its effect wears off. Knowing that you are protected, or not protected, while standing in front of a dragon is something of a problem.

One solution is to bring someone with you. Get them to count while you fight a dragon. They can give you a happy thumbs-up while protected and a sad thumbs-down when you're not.

Of course, they probably need antifire if they're going to assume that role. Which means a third party to give the second party a thumbs-up or thumbs-down. Yeah, we see the flaw in the plan.

name: Antipoison Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Removes poison and grants resistance to it. Made with irit and poison ichor.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Irit x1, Poison Ichor x1, Glass Vessel x1

description:
An antipoison potion applies the perk Antipoison II, which removes Poison effects and grants 66% resistance from future Poison effects, compared to 33% resistance from Antipoison. It is crafted with irit, poison ichor, and glass vessel.

(Journal)
Just because you're protected by antipoison, it doesn't mean that you should start glugging poison or poking yourself with poison-tipped arrows. Your body still needs to get rid of that poison, and it's not pleasant on the exit.

name: Avantoe
description:
Avantoe is an herb obtained by harvesting Avantoe plants. It can be farmed by planting avantoe seeds in a willow farming plot, with iron secateurs providing an increased yield when harvesting.

(Journal)
Everything about the avantoe is quickfire. It grows quickly, blooms fast, and is a superb catalyst, reacting quickly in potion-making. It's a plant in a rush, eager to germinate and get the next avantoe on its way. Meanwhile, I can spend an hour trying to work out what to eat today, and can stare at an empty space where a journal should be for even longer.

description: The brewing cauldron is used to brew various potions that can boost the player's abilities, increase experience gained, grant immunities to status effects, or restore their health. It will display all known recipes in its crafting menu and will draw from nearby linked storages. It does not have any shelter restrictions and can be placed without a foundation. It is learned when picking up clay for the first time.

name: Focused Fishing II

infobox.label: Source
infobox.value: Focused Fishing potion, Super Focused Fishing potion

description: Focused Fishing II is a perk given by drinking the Focused Fishing potion or the super Focused Fishing potion, increasing the experience gained when training the Fishing skill by 30% for 5 minutes (300 seconds) or 10 minutes (600 seconds) respectively.

name: Focused Fishing Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Fishing II Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Irit x1, Grilled Trout x1, Glass Vessel x1

description:
Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with irit, grilled trout, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
You often hear stories about great anglers who have that one marine animal they've never caught. A whale perhaps, or a darting salmon. Well, I had a friend once who had an enmity with a prawn. It was a big prawn, mind you, and every time he caught it, it would leap out of his net and get away. He accused that pawn of gloating: he believed it waited until he hauled in the net before scarpering.

It got to the point where my friend traded his week's wages for a fishing potion. Not a lesser or weak fishing potion: a third-tier, freshly made fishing potion. He was going to catch that prawn, even if he had to starve for days.

But the potion didn't make him any better at catching the prawn. Instead, he became attuned to the prawn. He was so aware that he knew what it was thinking. Now, every time the prawn escapes, my friend can hear it cackle and let out a little "doofus!".

name: Harralander

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A fragrant herb used in restorative potions.

description:
Harralander is a herb that is harvested from Harralander plants, found primarily in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

(Journal)
A bitter tasting herb that makes for a poor tea, yet is often used as a morning pick-me-up by people with no tastebuds. It’s useful in crafting certain potions.

name: Healing Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Recovers some lost health. Made with irit and redberries.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Irit x1, Dwellberries x2, Glass Vessel x1

description:
Healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 80 health points upon consumption. It is made with irit, 2 dwellberries, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Hold a healing potion in your hands and doubt might enter the mind. Do you drink it? Do you apply it directly to the wound? Is it a suppository? Well, allow us to clarify: it is taken orally.

(Trivia)
- Although the item requires dwellberries, the description mistakenly state it requires redberries instead.
- The potion was meant to be released with Dowdun Reach, but a bug had prevented players from unlocking the recipe, until it was patched. Even after the patch, the item was still bugged, as some players still cannot unlock it.

name: Irit

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Harvested from Thorny Irit Roots, used in potion making at the brewing cauldron.

description:
Irits are herbs acquired from destroying thorny irit roots and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 18 garou chits.

(Journal)
It is unsurprising that irit grows in Fellhollow, considering it has such a close association with the dead. Whereas normal irit grows around graveyards and near the temples of death deities, the irit in Fellhollow grows everywhere.

Yet, unlike its leafier version, the irit here is twisted and sharp. It is formed of thorny roots that writhe out of the ground and must be cut down to access the herb beneath. After all, the dead in Fellhollow refuse to stay buried without a fight, why wouldn’t the irit react the same?

name: Kwuarm

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A bitter green herb used to make potions.

description:
Kwuarm is a herb that must be farmed using kwuarm seeds found in Goblin, Garou, or skeleton packs.

(Journal)
This herb has travelled far to deliver its malicious benefits to the people of Ashenfall. Its name, in Dwarvish, means “warm death” since it causes a terrible burning fever if the sap is consumed.

When crushed down to release its sap and oils, this herb is a requirement in some of the deadliest and most dangerous poisonous mixtures.

name: Lesser Antipoison Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Removes poison and grants resistance to it.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Toadflax x1, Swamp Weed x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Lesser antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison, which removes Poison stacks and grants 33% resistance from Poison buildup for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with toadflax, swamp weed, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
While the weaker variant of antipoison is sufficient for everyday usage, there are some situations that require a more potent resistance. The toxic mists in Ghornfell, over the swamps, are more powerful than a weaker resistance will protect against. These lesser potions strengthen the immune system and keep the toxic miasma from the drinker’s blood. Imperfect, still, but a much greater chance of survival.

name: Lesser Attack Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Strikes INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with MELEE ATTACKS

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Snapdragon x1, Ground Granite x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Lesser Attack potion grants the perk Focused Strikes, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with melee attacks by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, ground granite, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
No one is entirely sure who invented this potion, but those not privy to it were invariably the losers on the battlefield. In ancient times, armies would be given doses of this potion before they were sent off to battle. It made them deadlier, faster, and vastly increased their chances of victory.

The Children of Shadows used to try to brew large quantities of this potion every time they went on a mission, so that they would have the edge were they ever caught. Many a guard could attest to the power of this potion, but fortunately, it didn't make up for a general lack of melee skill.

(Journal)
If you're one of those anglers who exclaim that fishing is 'about taking a load off' and 'more about relaxation than the end-product', then you might want to try a lesser focused fishing potion. It removes the need for excuses and offers a chance of actually catching fish. Your experience grows and you will soon be gathering catches on the regular.

As an added bonus, with a higher fishing level, you can look down on all the other anglers who claim they fish 'to take a load off'.

(Journal)
A step up from the weaker version, this potion allows the body to absorb more of the ambient anima, which, in turn, ramps up healing. The potion allows the drinker to shrug off greater physical trauma than before.

For years, herblore masters have worked on versions that might work on emotional trauma, but there has been little success to date.

name: Lesser Magic Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Casting INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with COMBAT SPELLS

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Snapdragon x1, Wild Anima x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Lesser Magic Potion grants the perk Focused Casting, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with combat spells by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, wild anima, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Although humans cannot use magic without runes, they can become quite proficient conduits for power. A wizard and a farmer in possession of the same runes do not produce the same results; the former far outshines the latter.

This revelation made some farmers pretty upset. For years, they had ranted to their cows and sheep about how wizards were just snooty uppity types with shiny rocks. Yet, faced with the evidence, there was no denying that a farmer and a wizard weren't equals in disguise.

One farmer wanted to level the playing field by bringing in a local witch who had a grudge against the snooty men in blue robes.

Between the two of them, they found a way to use a magical potion to improve a person's connection to their own latent magic. Those who drank the potion were able to cast spells more efficiently and with greater skill than they ever could before.

The farmer wanted to use this new advantage to raze the tower to the ground, put the wizards in their place, and claim magic as a tool of the people. Unfortunately, the witch envisioned a different future, one that sparkled with glittering gold coins.

She died happily, wealthier than she had ever dreamed and surrounded by adoring young suitors vying for a slice of her inheritance. The farmer died after being trampled to death by cows tired of his grumbling.

Marrentil (also spelled marrentill in books) is a herb found from harvesting a marrentill plant in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

(Journal)
A sweet smelling herb that is used as an ingredient in many poison remedies.

name: Plant Cure

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Used to cure diseased plants and bring them back to a healthy state.

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 1)
infobox.value: Weeds x2, Animal Bone x1, Clean Water x1

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 2)
infobox.value: Weeds x2, Animal Bone x1, Clean Water x1

description:
Plant cure is a potion that cures diseased plants and provides 2 Farming experience when used. It is made with 2 weeds, animal bone, and clean water in a stone range or a cooking range (unlike the other potions made in a brewing cauldron). It is learned at level 3 Farming and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

(Journal)
Fashioned from clean water, weeds and animal bones, this mixture leeches out the vitality from those ingredients and transfers it to the sick and dying plants in your care. Cooked over a range, this concoction was first thought to be the domain of druids and herblore masters, but in truth it was a cook who put the pieces together.

Old mother [sic] Potterington was much beloved by the people of Bramblemead. On weekends, when people allowed themselves brief breaks from their toils, she would whip up a great batch of something delicious and simmering, and neighbouring farmers would drop by for a meal.

This kindness extended not only to people, but to her garden and farming patches too. She whipped up a broth so infused with nutrients that Brassica Prime himself is said to have blessed it. When fed to plants, their withering and wilting leaves would stiffen and return to vibrancy — life and vitality theirs once again.

Now you can brew such a concoction yourself, so that your plants might always life their healthiest days.

name: Snapdragon

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A sweet-smelling herb used in restorative potions.

description:
Snapdragon is a herb that can be found by harvesting the Snapdragon plant in the Bloodblight Swamp or can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

(Journal)
Children are often disappointed that this plant does not resemble an actual dragon. There are no snapping motions in these colourful leaves, and a depressing lack of fire-breathing lizards in the stems.

name: Stamina Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: Consuming a stamina potion will prevent all loss of stamina for a short duration, however you'll need a moment to recover before you have another as such unbridled energy is taxing on the body.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Avantoe x1, Amylase Crystal x1, Glass Vessel x1

description:
Stamina potion grants the perk Stamina Potion, preventing stamina drain from all actions for 20 seconds. Upon using the potion, the player must wait roughly 75 seconds (1 minute and 15 seconds) starting from consumption to use another potion. This, effectively, means players must wait 55 seconds after the potion effect ends to use another dose if players want to multi-dose.

(Journal)
The frustrating thing about agility courses is that you can't keep doing them forever. Agility's final boss is lactic acid, and it likes to stick spears into your muscles and joints.

Well, the humble stamina potion is +1 against lactic acid. If you're planning on physical activity and want to flick the bird to exhaustion, then we would recommend making one or two.

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Antifire NEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Antifire Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description: Super Antifire potion grants the perk Antifire, which removes Burning stacks and grants 33% resistance from Burning buildup for 600 seconds (10 minutes). It is made by using an Antifire potion in an imbuing barrel.

name: Super Antipoison Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Antipoison II NEGATES and grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Antipoison Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison II, which negates and grants resistance to Poison for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

(Journal)
Once the desert was full of snakes, until they were banished below the sands by an angry goddess. Only rarely do they manage to break through the surface of the dunes to bite someone, and their venom has been concentrated so heavily by their solitude, that it’s lethal to anyone that suffers it.

Fortunately, the shamans were able to create this antipoison, stronger and more powerful than previous tiers. It has saved many lives."

name: Super Focused Agility Potion

(Journal)
This potion gives you lumber tunnel vision, where the tunnel is made of tasteful wood rather than bricks. All there is - aside from the tunnel - is you and the tree, mano et arboro. One of the greatest, most heated rivalries of all time.

name: Super Focused Artisan Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Artisan II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill

description:
Super Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan II, which increased the experience gained through the Artisan skill by 30% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

(Journal)
Fermented with wild anima, this potion is a concentrated and more powerful version of its predecessor. The effects last longer and yet the power of the potion loses none of its efficiency.

Be warned, after drinking this potion, you may find yourself dreaming of assembling furniture, painting little clay decorations, and a billion other little crafty things that you would never have dreamed of before.

Just beware not to dream of the forbidden macramé, for in its strange knots do dark secrets dwell.

name: Super Focused Attack Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Attack II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Attack Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made by using a Focused Attack potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to know nothing but bloodlust? To know nothing but the call for battle and the need to slaughter?

Well, with this potion, you can! Condensed and fermented alongside wild anima, this potion will flood your system with so much adrenaline and aggression, that you’ll be looking to cause destruction on a catastrophic scale.

name: Super Focused Construction Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Construction II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Construction Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made by using a Focused Construction potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
Ah, to be a zen-like architect, focused on nothing but crenulations and scaffolding. Such thoughts were nought but dreams before this potion, yet now you have a chance to soar to new heights of… err… masonry?

It’s hard to write about a potion that enhances your desire to build things. To wax lyrical about a liquid that grants greater XP when you craft new decorations and bigger stairs. Yet, here we are.

name: Super Focused Cooking Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Cooking II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the COOKING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Cooking Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made by using a Focused Cooking potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
This potion imbues you with the desire to bake. Cakes, pies, biscuits, battas, all things culinary become your obsession. While under its effects, you will grow to understand more about nutrition and flavour profiles. You will transcend the limits of your taste buds into realms of deliciousness that only Brassica Prime can comprehend.

Use this potion wisely.

name: Super Focused Farming Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Farming II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the FARMING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Farming Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made by using a Focused Farming potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
It's possible to imagine a super-focused angler or lumberjack, but a super-focused farmer? How much more can they get from a farming patch?

A super-focused farmer is a disconcerting beast. They will sit at the corner of a farming patch, staring intensely at a seed, willing it to grow. They will do this for hours, even days, depending on the dosage. I'm not sure if the plant feels self-conscious or a little guilty, but it works: the plant does actually grow at a faster rate.

name: Super Focused Fishing Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Fishing II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the FISHING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Fishing Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made by using a Focused Fishing potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
If you want evidence of the strength of a super focused fishing potion, then look no further than Granny Potterington, who got mixed up and accidentally poured some into her pond. She came back the next day to find that one single fish had caught and eaten all the other fish in the pond. It had a confused look on its face and blood across its mouth and fins. Potent stuff.

name: Super Focused Mining Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Mining II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the MINING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Mining Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description: Super Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made by using a Focused Mining potion in an imbuing barrel.

name: Super Focused Runecrafting Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Runecrafting II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Runecrafting Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made by using a Focused Runecrafting potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
I once met a magician and runecrafter who managed to heighten her senses through super focused runecrafting potions. Her party trick was to apply a blindfold and be handed several runes. She could tell you the exact runes by licking, sniffing and fondling the stones. I'm not entirely sure whether this was an ability gained from the potion, or if she was just oddly aware of the properties of runes.

A bit of a downside was that, if you made her a meal, drink or even passed close to her, she would say "ooh, that tastes a bit of air runes" or "you smell like a law rune". It's hard to know what to do with that information.

name: Super Focused Woodcutting Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Woodcutting II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Focused Woodcutting Potion x1, Wild Anima x1

description:
Super Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made by using a Focused Woodcutting potion in an imbuing barrel.

(Journal)
This potion gives you lumber tunnel vision, where the tunnel is made of tasteful wood rather than bricks. All there is - aside from the tunnel - is you and the tree, mano et arboro. One of the greatest, most heated rivalries of all time.

name: Super Lumberjack Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Lumberjack II REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 66%

description:
Super Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack II, which reduces the stamina cost of woodcutting by 66% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

(Journal)
Pour a lumberjack potion down your gullet, and you will feel like not tree could stop you. You will believe that you can move faster than a magic carpet, leap over trees with a single bound. You will believe that you can chop a forest with a single swing of your logging axe.

Well, we're here to tell you that there is a reasonably large delta between what you believe you can do and what you can actually do. So prepare to be a little disappointed when you sober up.

name: Super Quarrymaster Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Quarrymaster II REDUCES the STAMINA cost of MINING by 66%

description:
Super Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster II, which reduces the stamina cost of mining by 66% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

(Journal)
A super quarrymaster potion will give you supernatural stamina when it comes to mining rocks, but you should be careful. Potions have the annoying habit of wearing off, and it's only then that you realise you've got killer cramp, pins and needles, or miner's cough. There's no comedown quite like a quarrymaster comedown.

name: Toadflax

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A spicy tasting herb used in resistance potions.

description:
Toadflax is found by harvesting the Toadflax plants in the Bloodblight Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

(Journal)
One of the most popular plants with witches everywhere, as much as for the name as its [sic] use in herblore. One witch, a particularly odd duck called Henrietta, once tried to combine the herb with the amphibian of its namesake. The resulting monstrosity killed five people, before it could finally be put down.

name: Weak Antipoison Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Antipoison Negates and grants RESISTANCE to POISON effects

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Bittercap Mushroom x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison, which removes Poison stacks and grants 33% resistance from Poison buildup for 5-minutes (300 seconds). It is made with marrentil, bittercap mushroom, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Poison has always been a problem for hunters. The forests are full of venomous creatures, just waiting for a chance to strike. The difference between an edible mushroom and one filled with deadly toxins is hard to spot on a moonless night. Thus, the Antipoison Potion was one of the first potions to be created. A glorious catch-all that fought against all the venoms and toxins of the realm.

They’re also surprisingly good for a hangover.

name: Weak Focused Agility Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Agility Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Clay Vessel x1, Marrentil x1, Bronze Leaf x1

description: Weak Focused Agility potions grant the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with marrentill, bronze leaf, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

name: Weak Focused Artisan Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Artisan Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Redberries x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with marrentil, redberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Looking and smelling suspiciously like coffee, this potion lets crafters sit down and create their favorite things. Tapestries, wood carvings, anything that requires time and concentration, can be enhanced with the focus this potion provides.

name: Weak Focused Attack Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Attack Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Small Animal Fang x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with marrentil, small animal fang, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
This potion streamlines your vision and hones your reflexes. Your synapses surge with clarity and you find it easier to understand the nuance of the blade.

The Wild Knights relied heavily on these potions to train their new fighters during the decline of the Guthixian faith. With fewer numbers, it became more important to teach people quickly.

name: Weak Focused Construction Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Construction Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Flax x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made with marrentil, flax, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
This potion is sweet, yet strong. The ingredients have steeped within the mixture for some time and allowed it to increase in potency. While it's perfectly fine to drink it directly from the bottle, you find yourself wishing you had a nice mug to use instead.

Still, this potion makes you acutely (haha, see what I did there?) aware of angles. You can measure a plank of wood with just a few well placed glares. The inner architect in you revels at the new possibilities before you, and you find yourself planning much further ahead.

name: Weak Focused Cooking Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Cooking Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the COOKING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Cabbage x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made with marrentil, cabbage, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
It's easy to forget that cooking is more than just throwing ingredients into the pot and applying fire. There are balances of flavours; the subtle blending of ingredients to create that perfect combination. This potion assists in this by enhancing the chef's smell and tastebuds [sic], so they can tell just how much of an ingredient needs to be added for optimal results.

name: Weak Focused Farming Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Farming Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the FARMING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Weeds x1, Clay Vessel x1

description: Weak Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made with marrentil, weeds, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

name: Weak Focused Fishing Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Fishing Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Sauteed Shrimp x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with marrentil, sauteed shrimp, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
'Weak' and 'focused' may seem like an oxymoron, but you have to look at the terms from a different perspective. When we say 'focused' we mean you - the angler - and your concentration. It is a measure of how much you narrow your eyes, quell your breath, and attribute all of your senses to the timeless art of poking hooks into fish. This potion increases those faculties. You become so focused that nothing else in the world matters.

And by 'weak' we mean that the potion is a little bit rubbish at doing all of the above.

name: Weak Focused Mining Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Mining Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the MINING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Animal Bone x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made with marrentil, animal bone, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
This potion makes it easier to swing a pickaxe. Your muscles are more relaxed and able to handle greater strain, making it easier to strike at the ore, learning its weak points.

Druids used to whip up huge batches of this for visiting dwarves, who would mix it with beer for dubious results.

name: Weak Focused Runecrafting Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Runecrafting Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFTING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Coarse Animal Fur x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made with marrentil, coarse animal fur, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Ashenfall is the birthplace of runecrafting. When Guthix settled here, he discovered the strange anima pouring out of the ground; different strands of magic resonating with certain concepts and natural laws.

This potion lets you see the world as he did, just for a while. You can spot the colourful flows of anima as they shimmer in the air, and you learn how to trap them in the rune essence more effectively, creating the potential for future magic.

name: Weak Focused Woodcutting Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Focused Woodcutting Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Marrentil x1, Feathers x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made with marrentil, feathers, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Woodcutting is less about speed and strength, and more about precision. This potion hones your senses, allowing you to repeatedly attack the same spot on the tree trunk. The result is more efficiently felled trees and far fewer splinters.

name: Weak Healing Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A potion that restores a small amount of health.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Harralander x1, Redberries x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 40 health points upon consumption. It is made with harralander, redberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Alchemists have long strived to create potions to rid mankind of all their ills. Normally, these potions are regeneratives that boost the body's ability to repair itself by drawing in the ambient anima and infusing it into the blood and tissue of the drinker. On the mainland, this changes healing from days to a matter of hours. On Ashenfall, the results are far more pronounced.

The ambient anima of the region is so strong that wounds heal in moments. Cuts vanish as if they never were, wounds healing so quickly that even scars cannot form. Weaker versions of the potion burn themselves out before they can heal severe injuries, but the results are impressive nonetheless.

name: Weak Lumberjack Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Lumberjack REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 33%

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Harralander x1, Antler x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting by 33% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with harralander, antler, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
This potion helps you sleep all night and work all day. It gives you the feeling of well oiled elbow and shoulder joints, and it numbs the pain in your muscles from swinging an axe for long stretches at a time.

name: Weak Quarrymaster Potion

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: PERK: Quarrymaster REDUCES the STAMINA cost of Mining by 33%

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Harralander x1, Clay x1, Clay Vessel x1

description:
Weak Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster, which reduces the stamina cost of Mining by 33% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with harralander, clay, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

(Journal)
Mining is a strenuous task. Each swing of that pickaxe makes your muscles ache and your bones quiver. Exhaustion creeps into your soul and takes root, making it take longer and longer to gather that precious ore.

This potion acts as a pick-me-up. An energizing drink that makes you a monster of a miner, able to swing your pickaxe as though it barely weighs anything at all.

name: Weapon Poison

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A vial of Weapon Poison. Used in crafting Poison Arrows or to coat your equipped Melee Weapon with Poison for a short time.

infobox.label: Materials
infobox.value: Clay Vessel x1, Kwuarm x1, Poison Ichor x1

description:
Weapon poison is a potion that can be created at level 15 Ranged. This allows the player to poison their weapon (excluding tools such as pickaxes or logging axes), making their melee weapon or ranged ammunition poisonous for two minutes.

(Journal)
Used in crafting Poison Arrows or to coat your equipped Melee Weapon with Poison for a short time.

There are times in life where you really want someone to regret ever meeting you. It could be a long-held grudge, it could be on the battlefield, or it could be in a never-ending meeting that could so easily have been an email but has now persisted past your lunchbreak and you had so been looking forward to that sushi… ahem… sorry, where was I? Oh, yes, pain!

Poison is sometimes considered to be a coward’s weapon. Personally, I prefer to think of it as the smart weapon choice, after all, honour is only worth anything if you’re the winner of the battle. A corpse with honour still rots in the dirt. With a blade coated in poison, you can almost guarantee the death of your enemies, all it takes is a single nick and their fate is sealed.

An investment well worth making, if you ask me.

name: Corroded Jewellery

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A sinister piece of jewellery, corroded and burned. Perhaps you can learn something from it.

description: Corroded jewellery is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the unholy symbol. This vestige is given to the player after completing the quest, Wanted! in Dowdun Reach.

name: Dwellberry Glazed Roast Meat

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a deliciously fruity dwellberry glazing. Scrumptious!

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 1)
infobox.value: Dwellberries x2, Raw Rat Meat x2

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 2)
infobox.value: Dwellberries x2, Raw Bird Meat x2

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 3)
infobox.value: Dwellberries x2, Raw Farm Meat x2

infobox.label: Materials (Recipe 4)
infobox.value: Dwellberries x2, Raw Game Meat x2

description:
Dwellberry glazed roast meat is a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining dwellberries with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot. Eating the dish provides moderate sustenance (30) and a small amount of lifeward (5) when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry glazed roast meat.

(Journal)
Dwellberries boiled down into a thick sauce and liberally trailed across the meat. You may not expect the combination to work, but upon that first mouthful, your tastebuds will squirm in delight for this delicious combination.

name: Tome of Farming - Vol 1

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A book filled with knowledge about how to apply dirt and water to seeds. Awards a small amount of Farming XP.

description: The Tome of Farming - Vol 1 is a tier 1 tome that rewards the player 100 Farming experience.

name: Tome of Farming - Vol 2

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A book filled with knowledge about how to apply dirt and water to seeds. Awards a decent amount of Farming XP.

description: The Tome of Farming - Vol 2 is a tier 2 tome that rewards the player 400 Farming experience.

name: Tome of Fishing - Vol 1

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A book filled with knowledge about how to efficiently tire out fish. Awards a small amount of Fishing XP.

description: Tome of Fishing - Vol 1 is a skill tome that rewards the player 100 Fishing experience. Players can receive this tome through completing the quest, Shrimp Catcher.

name: Tome of Fishing - Vol 2

infobox.label: Description
infobox.value: A book filled with knowledge about how to efficiently tire out fish. Awards a decent amount of Fishing XP.

description: Tome of Fishing - Vol 2 is a skill tome that rewards the player 400 Fishing experience.
